newsitem.title: UK: Xenova to publish placing terms in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Xenova to publish placing terms in Nov.

text.p: U.K.-based drugs research company Xenova Group Plc said on Wednesday that it hoped to announce the terms of its 25 million stg share placing in the second half of November.

The Slough-based company, which is already listed on the U.S. Nasdaq exchange, said in its pathfinder prospectus that it planned to use proceeds from its listing on the London Stock Exchange to develop its most advanced drugs, which focus on cancer and cardiovascualr compounds.
It also intends to establish facilites and research teams at its newly formed U.S. subsidiary MetaXen, which it hopes will speed up its development of new products.
Xenova has two cancer drugs in clinical trials, which it hopes will combat drug-resistant tumors.
Last week it announced a drug delivery collaboration with the U.S. group Warner-Lambert Co which will result in Warner Lambert investing up to 2.0 million stg in Xenova.
